name: Dumbbell Lunge to Curl
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at each side with palms facing inward.
Step forward with one foot and bend both knees to lower into a lunge.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders, turning your palms up while holding the lunge steady.
Lower the dumbbells back to your sides as you push back to standing, then alternate lead legs.
tips: Keep your front heel planted and torso upright while you curl.
Keep your elbows pinned beside your ribs without swinging the dumbbells up.
